name: Quick 2-Minute Plant Snacks
equipment: A few pantry and fridge staples
instructions: Keep a few zero-prep plant-based options ready: fruit, roasted nuts, pre-made hummus with cut vegetables, or dried edamame.
Batch-roast a jar of chickpeas or nuts on the weekend so a crunchy, protein-rich snack is always one scoop away.
Read this as permission, not a rule -- convenience is what makes a habit sustainable.
Watch today's video for snacks that take under two minutes, then think through which ones are already plant-based.
